---
title: "Flags in the Firefly Meadow"
format: html
page-layout: full
code-copy: false
---

<style>
body {
  color: #f3efe2;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 12%, #314564 0, transparent 47%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #121b2b 0%, #17283a 48%, #192c2c 100%);
}

#quarto-content {
  max-width: 1000px;
  padding: 2rem 1.5rem 4rem;
}

h1.title {
  color: #fff4d6;
  font-family: Georgia, serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.intro {
  max-width: 42rem;
  margin: 0 auto 1.5rem;
  color: #d3dddb;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.meadow {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 150px;
  margin: 0 auto 0.75rem;
  border: 1px solid #879e8c66;
  border-radius: 1.25rem;
  box-shadow: 0 18px 55px #080f1c99;
}

.cell {
  max-width: 720px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.cell-output figure {
  margin: 1.5rem 0 0;
  padding: 1.5rem;
  border: 1px solid #a4b7a577;
  border-radius: 1rem;
  background: #101b20cc;
  box-shadow: 0 14px 40px #080f1c88;
}

.flag-stage {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 1.75rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

@keyframes fruit-dance {
  0%, 100% {
    transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg) scale(1);
  }
  25% {
    transform: translateY(-14px) rotate(-14deg) scale(1.1);
  }
  50% {
    transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg) scale(1);
  }
  75% {
    transform: translateY(-8px) rotate(14deg) scale(1.08);
  }
}

.dancing-fruit-container {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: center;
}

.dancing-fruit {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 3.5rem;
  animation: fruit-dance 0.85s infinite ease-in-out;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 6px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45));
}

.fruit-label {
  margin-top: 0.35rem;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: #dfd7be;
}

.cell-output figure img {
  max-height: 420px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0.5rem;
  background: #f8f6ef;
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
  object-fit: contain;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 24px #0008;
}

.cell-output figcaption {
  padding-top: 0.9rem;
  color: #e7d8aa;
  text-align: center;
  font-family: Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 1.15rem;
}

.form-label {
  color: #f3efe2;
}

select.form-select {
  color: #f7f1df;
  border-color: #83998a;
  background-color: #172528;
}
</style>

<p class="intro">Pick a flag and let it glow beneath the fireflies. A little night-garden interlude, with flags from [FlagCDN](https://flagcdn.com/).</p>

//| echo: false
flagCodes = "ad ae af ag ai al am ao aq ar as at au aw ax az ba bb bd be bf bg bh bi bj bl bm bn bo bq br bs bt bv bw by bz ca cc cd cf cg ch ci ck cl cm cn co cr cu cv cw cx cy cz de dj dk dm do dz ec ee eg eh er es et fi fj fk fm fo fr ga gb gb-eng gb-nir gb-sct gb-wls gd ge gf gg gh gi gl gm gn gp gq gr gs gt gu gw gy hk hm hn hr ht hu id ie il im in io iq ir is it je jm jo jp ke kg kh ki km kn kp kr kw ky kz la lb lc li lk lr ls lt lu lv ly ma mc md me mf mg mh mk ml mm mn mo mp mq mr ms mt mu mv mw mx my mz na nc ne nf ng ni nl no np nr nu nz om pa pe pf pg ph pk pl pm pn pr ps pt pw py qa re ro rs ru rw sa sb sc sd se sg sh si sj sk sl sm sn so sr ss st sv sx sy sz tc td tf tg th tj tk tl tm tn to tr tt tv tw tz ua ug um us uy uz va vc ve vg vi vn vu wf ws xk ye yt za zm zw".split(" ")

regionNames = new Intl.DisplayNames(["en"], { type: "region" })

subdivisionNames = new Map([
  ["gb-eng", "England"],
  ["gb-nir", "Northern Ireland"],
  ["gb-sct", "Scotland"],
  ["gb-wls", "Wales"]
])

flagOptions = flagCodes.map(code => ({
  code,
  name: subdivisionNames.get(code) || regionNames.of(code.toUpperCase()) || code.toUpperCase()
}))

viewof selectedFlag = Inputs.select(flagOptions, {
  label: "Select a flag",
  format: flag => flag.name
})

nationalFruits = new Map([
  ["jm", { name: "Ackee", emoji: "🍈" }],

html`<figure>
  <div class="flag-stage">
    <img
      src="flags/${selectedFlag.code}.png"
      alt="Flag of ${selectedFlag.name}"
      style="display: block; width: min(100%, 540px); height: auto;"
    >
    <div class="dancing-fruit-container">
      <span class="dancing-fruit" role="img" aria-label="${fruit.name}">${fruit.emoji}</span>
      <span class="fruit-label">${fruit.name}</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <figcaption>${selectedFlag.name}</figcaption>
</figure>`
